制作方此前做过13集AI短剧《三星堆：未来启示录》，两年前在平台免费上线，全网点: The production team previously made a 13-episode AI micro-drama, "Sanxingdui: Future Revelations," which launched free on the platform two years ago and attracted considerable views across the web
更深层的问题在于，该片从立项到上映历经几年时间，修改的速度赶不上AI技术迭代的速: The deeper problem lies in that the film took several years from initiation to release, and the pace of revision could not keep up with the speed of AI technology iteration
特别是，AI已经将观众的审美阈值拉高: In particular, AI has raised the audience's aesthetic threshold
以前斥巨资搭实景拍出来的大片，现在观众下意识觉得AI“也能如此”: Big-budget films shot on real sets are now something viewers instinctively feel AI "could do too"
当技术奇观变得稀松平常，AI电影真正的上限，便指向AI做不了的部分——剧本、表演: When technical spectacle becomes commonplace, the true ceiling of AI films points to the parts AI cannot do — script, performance, emotion, judgment
最终，人的上限决定了AI的上限: Ultimately, the ceiling of human capability determines the ceiling of AI
一些带着“首部”标签的AIGC（人工智能生成内容）作品，也在开播之初引发关注，播: Some works labeled "first" in the AI-generation race — AIGC (AI-generated content) works — initially also drew attention on debut, but their reception fell short of expectations
当然，个别作品的失利并不代表AI影视这条路行不通: Of course, the failure of individual works does not mean the AI film-and-television path is a dead end
长期看，先有低成本，再有足够多的尝试，然后筛出好作品，AIGC会给整个视听产业扩: In the long run, low costs come first, then enough experimentation, then sifting out good works; AIGC will expand the entire audiovisual industry
说到底，AI应该是赋能想象力的画笔，而不是掩盖内容空洞的噱头: Ultimately, AI should be a brush that empowers imagination, not a gimmick that covers up hollow content
表达严谨才能取信观众（看台人语）: Rigorous expression earns audience trust (Audience View)
纪录片《汤寿潜1911》以此开篇，用AIGC（人工智能生成内容）还原当时场景: Documentary "Tang Shouqian 1911" opens with this, using AIGC (AI-generated content) to recreate scenes of that time
从《危言》成书、保路运动到杭州光复，AI（人工智能）负责还原无法实拍的历史场景，: From the completion of "Weiyan" to the Railway Protection Movement to the Hangzhou restoration, AI was responsible for recreating historical scenes impossible to shoot live today, helping audiences concretely perceive Tang Shouqian's choices and sense of responsibility
综观全片，历史题材纪录片的创作，AI可堪辅助工具，史料仍是源泉: Looking at the whole film: in creating historical documentaries, AI can serve as an auxiliary tool, but historical materials remain the source
“创作友好型生态”面面观（艺海观澜）: A Full View of the "Creation-Friendly Ecosystem" (Art Sea Perspective)
AI将存在于文字和想象中的影片提前呈现，它不是替我们判断，而是让我们的判断发生得: AI presents films in text and imagination in advance; it does not judge for us, but makes our judgment happen earlier and with more concrete grounds
AI短剧快速增长是一个信号，AI长剧、互动引流等新形态会陆续出现，作品可以更直接: The rapid growth of AI micro-dramas is a signal; new forms such as AI long-form dramas and interactive traffic-driving will emerge one after another. Works can reach users more directly, and the boundaries with games, cultural tourism and derivative products are also opening up
分账模式重构了风险回报结构，依托中剧和AI剧这对成本可控、周期灵活的内容载体，创: The revenue-sharing model restructures the risk-return structure. Relying on mid-length dramas and AI dramas — content carriers with controllable costs and flexible cycles — creators can, in a lightweight way, first test original works on the market before developing follow-up series
AIGC把制作门槛打下来，这对内容行业意味着，左手要抓“奇观”，右手要抓“共情”: AIGC lowers the production threshold, which for the content industry means grasping "spectacle" with the left hand and "empathy" with the right
